comment: PMC Operator fighters (docs/systems/pmc-squad-ai.md; PmcOperatorRules): the hostile operatives UPmcSquadSubsystem::SpawnFighter makes from the operative Blueprint. looks: coat_material = a material instance for the Explorer_Coat slot (made by Scripts/Editor/create_pmc_operator_variants.py under /Game/Characters/Enemies/PMC/Operator; a missing asset falls back to the tint alone), tint_srgb = the coat tint (the operative's role-colour parameter), snow = the starting snow share of the jacket. weapon_pool: weighted draw per fighter from Content/Data/Weapons (DA_Weapon_<id>). factions: monsters_attack_pmc = zombies / hounds hunt PMC fighters too; pmc_self_defence_m = a fighter shoots a monster only when it hunts a mate within this distance; cold_applies = the cold affects the PMC like the player's men (pending the user's confirmation). rpg_gunner (the game designer 2026-11-09: 'PMC fighters must be able to use the RPG'; PmcOperatorRules::IsRpgGunner): a squad (one seed) has its RPG gunner with the chance share, at most max_per_squad, among fighter indices 0 .. slot_span - 1; he carries DA_Weapon_<weapon> on top of his pool weapon (in hands) and the shared launcher rule draws it (Content/Data/Combat/launcher_tactics.json); share 0 = no PMC gunners.
